purpose: Select one externally least-trivially-explained target from the 35 cross-channel-supported frozen candidates without visual cherry-picking.
selection_rule: Sort the 35 supported candidates by frozen aggregate_score descending.
For each candidate, query georeferenced GSI/MI and NMS wreck records and official seabed classification at the frozen coordinate.
PRIMARY shortlist eligibility: no georeferenced wreck record within 500 m in either official wreck source AND containing official FOLK_5 class is neither Rock nor missing/unclassified.
Select the first eligible candidate in frozen score order.
If primary shortlist is empty, FALLBACK: select the highest-score candidate with no georeferenced wreck record within 500 m regardless of substrate class.
Do not use imagery, names, historical narratives, or subjective shape impressions to choose the target.
next_after_selection: Independent visual/report/source hunt for the single frozen selected target.
